latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: AI-verified gamified habit tracking inspired by Solo Leveling. 6 stats (STR/INT/VIT/AGI/PER/CHA), ranks F-S, daily quests, dungeons, titles, streak multipliers, 5 preset templates (developer/fitness/student/creative/balanced), configurable for any habits/goals. The System persona — cold, ruthless accountability.
